product.name: Lians
product.summary: AI that remembers right—and can show you why. Lians gives people control over what AI remembers, uses less context to do useful work, and gives organizations point-in-time evidence of what shaped important decisions. On the published LoCoMo benchmark, Lians reached 90.0% judged accuracy with 85.4% fewer context tokens than full-context prompting.

workflow.label: Remember
workflow.detail: Keep the facts, preferences, decisions, outcomes, and reviewed lessons that matter across conversations and applications.

workflow.label: Control
workflow.detail: Inspect, correct, and forget memory. The Memory Firewall keeps stale, superseded, erased, or unauthorized records out of present context.

workflow.label: Prove
workflow.detail: A Memory Receipt shows which authorized memories were used or excluded, when they were learned, and where they came from.

workflow.label: Improve
workflow.detail: Carry forward outcomes and reviewed lessons, then retrieve the smallest useful context so AI can do more useful work per token.

surfaces.label: Memory Receipts
surfaces.detail: Human-readable recall and context evidence alongside canonical content-addressed receipts in the API, SDKs, and hosted AI tools.

surfaces.label: Memory Controls
surfaces.detail: List current or historical memories, make append-only corrections, and explicitly forget individual records from local or hosted applications.

surfaces.label: Decision Ledger
surfaces.detail: Point-in-time reconstruction, signed Evidence Packs, completeness grades, information barriers, and change blast-radius analysis for organizations.

surfaces.label: Managed cloud
surfaces.detail: A managed path for people and organizations that want portable, provider-neutral memory operated for them instead of self-hosting.
